system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Kubernetes default-deny NetworkPolicy applied to all Pods in the 'payments' namespace, blocking all ingress and egress traffic except explicitly allowed flows.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Generate a Kubernetes default-deny NetworkPolicy applied to all Pods in the 'payments' namespace, blocking all ingress and egress traffic except explicitly allowed flows.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
  namespace: payments
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: default-deny-all
    app.kubernetes.io/component: network-policy
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: payments
  annotations:
    description: "Default-deny baseline policy. Blocks all ingress and egress traffic for all Pods in the 'payments' namespace. Additional NetworkPolicies must explicitly allow required flows."
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress: []
  egress: []
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-dns-egress
  namespace: payments
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: allow-dns-egress
    app.kubernetes.io/component: network-policy
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: payments
  annotations:
    description: "Explicitly allow egress DNS resolution to kube-dns/CoreDNS in kube-system. Required for Pods to resolve service names."
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              k8s-app: kube-dns
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53
